description: High-value customers who purchase frequently across web and store channels.
recommended_action: Use cross-sell bundles and loyalty offers to increase lifetime value.

description: Lower-value customers with the longest time since purchase and comparatively high web visits.
recommended_action: Use timely win-back messages, targeted incentives, and friction-reduction experiments.

description: Lower-income, lower-spending customers who have purchased relatively recently.
recommended_action: Nurture with entry-level offers and relevant product recommendations.

description: Highest-value customers: strongest income and total spending with low browsing activity.
recommended_action: Offer exclusive rewards, early access, and concierge-style retention experiences.
